items.title: Define deterministic Cell 03 shard plan without changing cell semantics
items.context: Partition the existing expected Cell 03 cellKey set by stable ordered index modulo shard count. Acceptance: N shards cover all 1,152 expected keys exactly once; invalid shard indexes and digest drift fail closed.

happy.desc: Shard plan covers every expected Cell03 key exactly once.

edge.desc: Invalid shard indexes or counts fail closed.

adversarial.desc: Duplicate or missing key partition cannot pass selfcheck.

items.userSees: node experiments/multi-model-ablation/cell03-shards/selfcheck.mjs reports coverage=1152 and invalid shard inputs fail closed.

items.title: Write per-shard rows and workspaces instead of sharing the main Cell 03 ledger
items.context: A shard runner must write to its own shard directory and must not append directly to the canonical cell03-rows.jsonl during parallel execution. Acceptance: shard dry-runs leave canonical rows untouched and same-shard concurrent attempts fail closed.

happy.desc: Shard runner writes only shard-local output in fixture/dry-run mode.

edge.desc: Canonical Cell03 rows stay untouched by shard selfcheck.

items.userSees: node experiments/multi-model-ablation/cell03-shards/selfcheck.mjs reports lockReject=pass and confirms shard output stays local.

items.title: Add merge validator for shard outputs
items.context: Merge logic must verify identical protocol, prompt, tool, task, snapshot, runner, story/window binding, shard manifest digest, and no duplicate final rows before writing or reporting merged output. Acceptance: fixture duplicate/missing/digest-drift shards are rejected.

happy.desc: Complete fixture shard set merges with zero duplicates and zero missing keys.

edge.desc: Partial shard set reports missing keys and does not write canonical evidence.

adversarial.desc: Duplicate final rows, shard-count mismatch, and digest drift are rejected.

items.userSees: node experiments/multi-model-ablation/cell03-shards/selfcheck.mjs reports mergeComplete=pass, duplicateReject=pass, missingReject=pass, and digestDriftReject=pass.

items.title: Document safe operator usage and explicit non-goals
items.context: README must explain that this story enables safe shard tooling only and does not itself run provider rows, unlock Cell 06, or alter paper claims. It must distinguish story-level Parallel Wave from Cell03 row-level sharding.

happy.desc: Docs show safe shard plan, fixture shard output, and merge validation commands.

edge.desc: Docs distinguish Parallel Wave story scheduling from Cell03 row sharding.

adversarial.desc: Docs do not imply provider execution, Cell06 unlock, Phase2 unlock, or paper claim unlock.

items.userSees: The Cell03 shard README shows plan, fixture shard, and merge commands plus explicit non-goals for provider execution and claim unlocks.
